content.scenario: You are a new assistant at the university library. Listen to your supervisor and repeat what she says. Repeat only once.

sentences.text: The quiet study rooms are on the second floor.
Students need their ID cards to borrow books.
Please remind visitors that food is not allowed near the computers.
Books that are returned late will be charged a small fee each day.
If someone needs help finding an article, show them how to use the online catalog.
During exam week, the library stays open until midnight, so we usually need extra staff in the evenings.
